_comment: Claude Code with BOTH local Qwen and the real Anthropic models available in one
session. Use this instead of claude-qwen.json when you want to switch:
Claude Code takes a single ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL for the whole session, so the only
way to keep both is to route by model name: anything containing 'qwen' goes to the
local server, everything else is forwarded to api.anthropic.com with its headers
untouched. Switch with /model at any time.
ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN is deliberately NOT set here. The router forwards auth headers
verbatim, so your existing claude.ai login keeps working for the Anthropic models.
Setting a dummy token (as claude-qwen.json does) would break that half.
ROUTER_PASSTHROUGH=1 matters: the router's two request fixups exist for vLLM, and
hoist_system is actively harmful against SGLang -- our chat template renders
mid-conversation system turns as <system-reminder> blocks in place, and hoisting
would move them to the top and lose their position.
